name: On Shutdown
description: An automation to perform right before the node shuts down. See [`on_shutdown`](https://esphome.io/components/esphome/#esphome-on_shutdown).

config_entries.label: Priority
config_entries.description: The priority to execute your custom shutdown code. A higher value means a high priority and in case of shutdown triggers that the code is executed **later**. Priority is used primarily for the initialization order of components. Shutdowns for these components are handled in *reverse* order, such that e.g. sensors (600) are shutdown before the hardware components (800) they depend on. Please note this is an ESPHome-internal value and any change will not be marked as a breaking change. Defaults to `600`. For priority values refer to the list in the [`on_boot`](https://esphome.io/components/esphome/#esphome-on_boot) section.
